steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Was that an earthquake just now?

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Yeah!!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: We're so close to the stage, after all! Did you see that? Did you see D.D.D.'s expression?! How did she do that?!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: She already left the stage, don't always be such a fanboy... Wait, isn't it shaking again?

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Oh come on, it's probably just the subwoofer... Wait...

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: H-huh...? You felt that too?

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: ...Let's go!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Wh-what?!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Don't ask questions, just come with me!

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: Stop pushing! Some personal space here!

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: You're stepping on my foot!! Get out of my face!!

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: Someone fainted! Watch out!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Wh-why is everyone panicking? Don't tell me...

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Oh my god...

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: ...It's Emperor.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Ahem, nice weather we're having.
(Cheering)

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Emperor! It's really him!! Wooowwww...!

steps.name: Male Tourist
steps.text: Don't be stupid! It's THE EMPEROR! And you still think it's some earthquake?!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: No, I'm just too excited, from seeing... Wait, I kind of... can't breathe...

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Mister Emperor, this way please.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen! Please move back! Stand behind the line!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hey, young man, that Savran over there.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: It's okay. Let them come closer.

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: But Mister Emperor, you still have a performance later. If some kind of accident were to happen...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Accident?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You mean an attempted shooting, assassination, kidnapping, suicide threat, or something along those lines?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Do you think those things can stop me? Me?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: No, those things shall only become a part of my show, just like how rhythm breaks apart the meaning of words. Do you understand?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Well, no...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: To put it simply, it's all theatrics. Just relax. I promise, Siren won't blame you for it.
(Cheering)

steps.name: Audience
steps.text: Emperor!! Emperor!! Emperor!!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Ah, you're here. Come, don't be nervous. Just relax, muster up some bravery, and believe in yourself.

steps.name: Strange-Looking Tourist
steps.text: Columbia's Rap God? You're nothing but a thug, a mongrel that got a little lucky...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Louder, pal, let me hear you! Hey, Savran, don't drive him away. Give him the mic. Don't worry. Just do as I say.

steps.name: Strange-Looking Tourist
steps.text: You ruined our lives, but you still sit atop so much wealth... You, you deserve only death!!

steps.name: Female Tourist
steps.text: Noooo! He has a crossbow! Take cover!

steps.name: Strange-Looking Tourist
steps.text: Don't blame me. That's right, it's all your fault. Just how many singers were sacrificed for your so-called 'rap empire'...

steps.name: Strange-Looking Tourist
steps.text: Emperor? Eat dirt, you bottom-feeding penguin!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Ahaha, let me think about that one. Who's the one playing dirty? Riling up the media, manipulating public opinion, personal attacks, and now even a shooting attempt? Hmph.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You think I'd forget who you are just because you decided to roll around in the sewers? Will pointing your weapon at these youngsters satisfy you, 'Songster?'

steps.name: Strange-Looking Tourist
steps.text: You...!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: If I wasn't such a juicy target for you, how many rising stars would you have continued to 'eliminate' just for not suiting your tastes?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: How long did you think you'd get away with spitting on the entirety of Columbia while stuffing your bathtub full of money?

steps.name: Strange-Looking Tourist
steps.text: Shut up! Just die!

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Protect Mister Emperor!

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Mister Emperor has been shot! Wait... what?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Mister Emperor was the one who shot first? That bastard's crossbow went flying!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Ratatat tat! Bang!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: How strange. You were the one running your muzzle, but how come my muzzle is smoking first? Why don't ya take a guess?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Is it because ya got no game, or is my brilliance that is to blame?

steps.name: Strange-Looking Tourist
steps.text: Guh... You... even brought guns with you...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: If you die several times every day, there are games that you just won't play.

steps.name: Strange-Looking Tourist
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Do you really... think I'm alone? Think about all the enemies you've made. You won't leave Siesta alive!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: My past is more expansive than this sea of falsity; so where are these 'enemies' that await my majesty?

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Mister Emperor! Many of his rabble are hidden among the audience. We can't deal with all of them...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: That's all right. Don't panic. Just maintain the order here, and leave the rest to the professionals.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Professionals, like Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: ...If I remember properly, weren't we supposed to be on vacation? Just out of curiosity, are we getting paid overtime for this?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I could use some exercise after being cooped up in that hotel room.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Tex- err, I mean, 'Sora,' that's... because you stayed in the hotel reading books the whole time...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Right, that was part of the agreement. Are you able to adapt to the battlefield?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: No problem!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Boss, we're all done here. Remember to snag me the front row seats for tomorrow's show!

steps.name: Bodyguard
steps.text: Mister Emperor, wh-who are these people?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We are the Boss's... Well, Mister Emperor's private bodyguards.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: We're a logistics company though.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well, since the beginning, our business covers quite a wide range of things. We even bought a jazz bar at some point, right?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: There were also those Siracusan gangs that really liked being our punching bags. They've been behaving better recently though.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: How many fights do you think we have in Lungmen every month?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: When it comes to brawls and firefights, we're the best you're going to find.

steps.name: Agitated Audience
steps.text: I've been waiting for this moment! Penguin from the West! Since you finally dared to expose yourself, die!!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: ...Did you guys establish the Guild of Hypocrites or something? Very well, I was about to say the same thing about you bunch.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Texas, do it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Got... Oops.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: ...Got it! It's showtime!
